boundary_event.evidence: I think I'm out on this one. Consumer is about half of what we do at Precursor. And I don't think this is a shortcoming of like your approach. I think just looking at where headset technology is and where capture technology is, I just worry that there's too much friction to really get a large number of people into the experience, and I think you're gonna need a large number of people in the experience to make the consumer subscription piece work.
